unit_cn: Unit 3 Fascinating Parks 迷人的公园
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 3 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、国家公园/湖区/主题公园/自然保护区主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.example_en: No new buildings are allowed within the park boundaries.
words.example_cn: 公园边界内不允许新建任何建筑。

words.example_en: Trees and bushes grow along the riversides in the park.
words.example_cn: 公园里河岸边长满了树木和灌木。

words.example_en: Sarek is a vast park with no roads or towns.
words.example_cn: 萨雷克是一座没有道路和城镇的辽阔公园。

words.example_en: The Rapa River flows through the valley below the mountains.
words.example_cn: 拉帕河流经群山下方的山谷。

words.example_en: I walked over to the mountain edge to watch the river.
words.example_cn: 我走到山边去看那条河。

words.meaning_cn: 偏远的;遥远的;关系疏远的
words.example_en: The park lies in a remote part of northern Sweden.
words.example_cn: 这座公园位于瑞典北部一处偏远地带。

words.example_en: When the ice melted, it left behind about a hundred glaciers.
words.example_cn: 冰雪融化后,留下了大约一百条冰川。

words.example_en: Every spring a few Sami still follow their reindeer into the valleys.
words.example_cn: 每年春天,仍有少数萨米人跟着驯鹿走进山谷。

words.example_en: The Sami people made this northern territory their home.
words.example_cn: 萨米人把这片北方的土地当作自己的家园。

words.meaning_cn: 看得见的;可见的;明显的
words.example_en: An ancient cottage is visible at the far side of the valley.
words.example_cn: 在山谷的另一头,可以看见一座古老的小屋。

words.example_en: Some Sami still live in old cottages in the mountain valleys.
words.example_cn: 一些萨米人仍住在山谷里的旧小屋中。

words.example_en: The new park stretches all the way to the border with Russia.
words.example_cn: 这座新公园一直延伸到与俄罗斯接壤的边境。

words.example_en: It is a rare chance to explore such a wild and quiet place.
words.example_cn: 探索如此荒野而宁静的地方是一次难得的机会。

words.example_en: As you wander around the park, you may see deer feeding on grass.
words.example_cn: 当你在公园里漫步时,可能会看到鹿在吃草。

words.example_en: The guide drew the best route across the park on the map.
words.example_cn: 向导在地图上画出了穿越公园的最佳路线。

words.meaning_cn: 走廊;过道;通道;狭长地带
words.example_en: You can walk through an underwater corridor and watch the fish.
words.example_cn: 你可以穿过一条水下走廊观赏鱼群。

words.example_en: In the evening we watched a beautiful fountain performance.
words.example_cn: 傍晚我们观看了一场美丽的喷泉表演。

words.example_en: We rented a pedal boat and rowed across the lake.
words.example_cn: 我们租了一条脚踏船划过湖面。

words.example_en: The park has rides from enormous swinging ships to free-fall drops.
words.example_cn: 公园里既有巨大的摇摆船,也有自由落体跳楼机。

words.example_en: The giant ship swings back and forth high above the ground.
words.example_cn: 那艘巨大的船在高空中前后摆动。

words.meaning_cn: 难以置信的;极好的;极大的
words.example_en: There is an incredible theme park that will appeal to almost everyone.
words.example_cn: 有一座令人难以置信的主题公园,几乎能吸引每个人。

words.example_en: At night you can see the splendid parade and fireworks display.
words.example_cn: 夜晚你可以观赏壮丽的游行和烟花表演。

words.example_en: Dollywood has a superb wooden roller coaster called Thunderhead.
words.example_cn: 多莉坞有一座极佳的木制过山车,名叫雷霆头。

words.example_en: If it is ocean entertainment you want, come to this park.
words.example_cn: 如果你想要海洋娱乐,就来这座公园吧。

words.example_en: There are theme parks for almost everything, from food to history.
words.example_cn: 几乎万物都有相应的主题公园,从美食到历史。

words.example_en: The fireworks display lit up the whole night sky over the park.
words.example_cn: 烟花表演照亮了公园上空的整个夜空。

words.example_en: Skilled workers make wood, glass, and iron objects in the old way.
words.example_cn: 熟练工人用传统方式制作木器、玻璃器和铁器。

words.example_en: Riding on the only working steam engine here is a special treat.
words.example_cn: 乘坐这里唯一还在运行的蒸汽机车是一种特别的享受。

words.example_en: The national park now protects about thirty-five tigers and seventy leopards.
words.example_cn: 这座国家公园如今保护着约三十五只虎和七十只豹。

words.example_en: At the ocean park you can even see real polar bears.
words.example_cn: 在海洋公园你甚至能看到真正的北极熊。

words.example_en: The wetland park is called the green lungs of the city.
words.example_cn: 这座湿地公园被称为这座城市的绿肺。

words.example_en: Park rules prohibit hunting and picking flowers inside the reserve.
words.example_cn: 公园规定禁止在保护区内狩猎和采花。

words.example_en: A prohibition on hunting helped the rare animals slowly increase.
words.example_cn: 狩猎禁令帮助这些珍稀动物数量缓慢回升。

words.example_en: All the new buildings were designed in a traditional fashion.
words.example_cn: 所有新建筑都以传统的方式设计。

words.example_en: He ordered the dish labelled "Pumpkin Pie and Ice Cream".
words.example_cn: 他点了那道标着"南瓜派配冰激凌"的菜。

words.example_en: A travel journalist wrote a long report about the hidden park.
words.example_cn: 一位旅行记者写了一篇关于这座隐秘公园的长篇报道。

words.example_en: She writes a weekly travel column about national parks.
words.example_cn: 她每周写一个关于国家公园的旅行专栏。

words.example_en: The cold mountain air made me sneeze again and again.
words.example_cn: 寒冷的山间空气让我一次又一次地打喷嚏。

words.example_en: I ate some sweet and sour berries growing near my tent.
words.example_cn: 我吃了一些长在帐篷附近又甜又酸的浆果。

words.example_en: The candy shop sells pie and ice cream made in the old way.
words.example_cn: 那家糖果店出售用老办法制作的派和冰激凌。

words.example_en: He bought a traditional tea set with a nice teapot at the shop.
words.example_cn: 他在店里买了一套带漂亮茶壶的传统茶具。

words.example_en: I woke to the sound of the wind hitting the cloth of my tent.
words.example_cn: 我被风拍打帐篷布的声音吵醒。

words.example_en: Being in such a wild place makes me feel blessed to be alive.
words.example_cn: 身处如此荒野之地,让我感到活着是一种幸福。

words.example_en: Hiking through the mountains was tiring but truly rewarding.
words.example_cn: 徒步穿越群山虽然累,却真的很值得。

words.example_en: At the water park you can join a water fight against pirates.
words.example_cn: 在水上公园你可以加入一场对抗海盗的水仗。

words.example_en: The park restaurant offers a buffet dinner with tasty local food.
words.example_cn: 公园餐厅提供一顿有美味当地食物的自助晚餐。
